name: Bandwidth Tracker
description: Tracks who logs in and how much bandwidth each user streams. Samples the real bitrate of every active stream, excludes paused time, and reports per-user, per-day and live totals.
overview: Per-user login and streaming bandwidth tracking.

versions.changelog: 1.0.0.0: First release. Login tracking (auth events + session fallback, deduped), live bitrate sampling of every stream, per-user / per-day / live totals, admin API + in-app Bandwidth Usage page, per-user /Bandwidth/Me endpoint.

name: Aeon Profiles
description: Several profiles under one account. Each profile is a real Jellyfin user grouped under the account: own watch history, optional PIN, optional kids limits. Account owner or admins manage profiles.

versions.changelog: 1.1.0.0: Per-title blocks for any profile (enforced server-wide via Jellyfin blocked tags), blocked-title management in the Profiles page, big avatar library (48 pictures, custom emoji, 12 colors). 1.0.0.0: first release.

name: Aeon Home
description: Netflix-style home rows for Jellyfin: Top Picks, Because You Watched, Top 10 on this server — per profile, computed locally, plus thumbs ratings and hide-from-history.
overview: A For You home with recommendations, Top 10, thumbs and hiding.

versions.changelog: 1.0.0.0: First release. For You page with Top Picks per user/profile, Because You Watched rows, server-wide Top 10; thumbs ratings (down / up / double-up) that feed the recommendations; hide-from-history (not interested) with unhide. All computed locally from the server's own data; parental controls and Aeon Profiles title blocks are honored.

name: Aeon Identify
description: An identification inbox for Jellyfin: finds video files that look mislabeled or unidentified and asks you what show they really are, then fixes the match and the file name.
overview: Mislabeled-file inbox that asks you what each file really is.

versions.changelog: 1.0.0.0: First release. Identify Queue (main menu): scans movies, series and episodes for files that look mislabeled — never identified, meaningless file names, file name vs matched title/year disagreements, episodes with no season/episode number — and asks the admin what each one really is. Answers go through Jellyfin's own RemoteSearch/Apply identify flow; an optional rename then renames the file to the canonical name (same folder, never overwrites). 'It's actually correct' dismissals persist.

name: AeonPS1
description: Adds AeonPS1 to AeonTV: a PS1 games shelf in the web client — folder scan, real serial/region detection, disc streaming, and Play hand-off to the AeonPS1 app.
overview: Your PlayStation games, on a shelf inside AeonTV.

versions.changelog: 1.0.0.0: First release. A PlayStation games shelf for AeonTV: scans a configured games folder for PS1 disc images (.iso/.bin/.cue/.img/.pbp/.chd), reads each disc's serial and region from the disc bytes, detects disc numbers, presents the shelf in a main-menu 'AeonPS1' page with Play hand-off intent links to the AeonPS1 app (com.aeonps1.firetv) plus direct disc downloads with HTTP range support. API: GET /PS1/Games, GET /PS1/Games/{id}/Disc, GET /PS1/Status, POST /PS1/Rescan.
